summary: Phase-3 (Cloud Photos + Albums, Hall Booking, Samaj-specific roles, Trending hashtags, FCM devices) tested end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_photos_hall.py — 40 tests, 39 passing (97.5%). Verified: album CRUD + photos + Samaj-B isolation (single-GET 404 for non-member, upload 403), member cannot create public album (resolve_visibility forbids), hall list canManage flag flips with role, member 403 on POST /halls and GET /admin/bookings, booking overlap -> 409, capacity overflow -> 400, booking create/cancel round-trip, admin approve/reject notify, samaj-specific role switching (event_manager on default -> canManage true, activate Samaj B -> canManage false, POST /halls -> 403), trending endpoint, FCM device register/delete with 400 on short token, and 0x401 across /auth/me /members /search /posts /events /conversations /live/rooms /notifications /albums /halls /hashtags/trending for BOTH member and super admin. Frontend: hard-reload of /members /search?q=a /social /events /messages /live /notifications /profile /photos /hall as member 9000000002 -> ZERO 401 responses on ALL 10 routes; each page rendered. Photos page: new-album-btn + albums-grid render. Hall page: 3 hall cards (Samaj Hall + others), 3 book-hall-{id} buttons, my-bookings container present; booking-dialog opens with booking-date and booking-submit. Social page: trending-hashtags bar renders with 7 trending-{tag} chips. 1 REAL BUG FOUND: Samaj isolation leak — while active samaj is B, GET /api/albums still returns the creator's own default-samaj samaj-visibility albums, and GET /api/albums/{id} returns 200 (not 404) for that album. Root cause in /app/backend/core.py: visible_query_docs adds `where('createdBy','==',u.id)` query which pulls creator's docs across samajs, and can_view() short-circuits to True on `doc.createdBy == u.id` regardless of active samaj. This same pattern likely leaks posts/events/etc. across active-samaj context.

critical.issue: Samaj isolation leak: creator sees their own default-samaj album while activeSamajId=Samaj B (list contains it; single-GET returns 200 instead of expected 404). Root cause in core.py visible_query_docs (createdBy branch) and can_view (createdBy short-circuit). Affects albums and likely posts/events/photos since they share the same helpers.

ui_bugs.issue: In one browser automation run, clicking [data-testid=new-album-btn] did not open [data-testid=album-dialog] within 4s (screenshot ended up on /live route). Manual retry did not reproduce open either. Possibly a shadcn Dialog portal timing issue or focus stolen by bottom nav. New-album-btn itself is visible and rendered. Recommend verifying in real browser session.

action_items: Fix samaj isolation in core.visible_query_docs and can_view: exclude createdBy-owned docs whose samajId != user.activeSamajId when visibility='samaj' (creators should only see their own doc within its samaj context). Apply to albums, posts, events, photos.
Investigate /photos new-album-btn -> album-dialog open flow in a real browser (Dialog portal may be delayed or an overlay intercepts). Add data-testid on Dialog overlay for testing if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: core.visible_query_docs: fanning out with createdBy and visibility-in queries and then relying on can_view is correct in spirit but createdBy leaks cross-samaj: creator can see their samaj-only docs from another samaj context. Add filter `d.samajId == u.activeSamajId or d.visibility in ('all_samaj','public') or u.id in d.allowedUserIds` in can_view for creator branch.
routes_photos._album_visible/_load_album depend entirely on can_view; fixing can_view will implicitly fix single-album 404 requirement.
routes_booking._hall uses `h.samajId != activeSamajId and not is_samaj_admin(...)` to 404 non-member — correct, matches requirement (member on Samaj B gets 404 on default hall).
routes_booking.create_booking capacity check uses `int(h.capacity or 0)`; passes required 400 test.
routes_photos.create_album stores visibility via resolve_visibility (rejects public for members with 403). Verified.
FCM /api/devices register enforces token length via validator; short token -> 400 verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-3 backend + basic UI covered. The only functional bug is samaj isolation in core.py helpers affecting cross-samaj visibility of creator's own docs. When retesting after fix, re-run test_phase3_photos_hall.py::TestAlbumsAndPhotos::test_samaj_b_isolation_get_404_and_upload_403 and add a similar check for /api/posts and /api/events. For UI album creation flow, if AlbumDialog still fails to open in automation, capture page HTML after click to see if DialogContent is rendered but hidden vs never rendered.
rca of the issue: Samaj isolation leak: /app/backend/core.py `visible_query_docs` queries `createdBy == u.id` returning all creator-owned docs across samajs; and `can_view` returns True when `doc.createdBy == u.id` before checking samaj membership. Result: with activeSamajId=Samaj B, user still sees their default-samaj samaj-visibility album (list + single GET 200). Repro: (1) activate default, POST /albums {visibility:samaj}; (2) POST /samaj/{SAMAJ_B}/activate; (3) GET /albums -> album present; GET /albums/{id} -> 200. Fix: in can_view creator branch require `doc.samajId == u.activeSamajId or doc.visibility in ('all_samaj','public') or u.id in doc.allowedUserIds`. Also drop `createdBy` fan-out in visible_query_docs OR post-filter by samaj/visibility.
